cat >> /home/lane/MythosMini/journal.md <<'EOF'

## [2026-06-12 14:20] — double-decoder efficiency measurement: real time-to-result

**TL;DR:** Added a timing harness to tests/double_decoder.py (commits d8b45bb, e150063): train_steps (resumable inner loop extracted from train_model), time_to_target (interleaved training of double pair vs baseline with periodic held-out eval, recording training-only wall seconds to a target accuracy), measure_inference_seconds, and shared decode helpers greedy_double_decode/voted_double_decode. 23 experiment tests pass; pyaot clean. Measurements (CPU, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""): time-to-90% — 3-digit: baseline wins wall-clock (4.5–5.4 s vs double 7.4–8.0 s; identical step counts, double pays the sequential two-model tax); 5-digit: seed-split — seed 20260612 baseline 16.5 s vs double 23.8 s (600 vs 500 steps), seed 7 double 11.5 s vs baseline 20.8 s (400 vs 1100 steps). Inference latency (1200-step-trained models): greedy double costs ~2.1x baseline batched (46.8 vs 22.0 ms / 500 problems at 3 digits; 115.7 vs 76.5 at 5) but near-parity single-prompt (2.3 vs 1.6 ms at 3 digits; 3.3 vs 3.1 at 5); vote-of-8 is ~9-10x batched, ~10-19x single.

**Long description:** time_to_target trains thinker, talker, and baseline in eval_interval rounds (100 steps) with fresh AdamW each and per-model persistent batch generators; the double clock sums thinker+talker train_steps wall time via perf_counter (eval excluded); first crossing of 0.90 held-out exact match records seconds and steps; -1.0 sentinel if never reached within config.steps (cap 2400). measure_inference_seconds does one untimed warmup pass per method then averages `repeats=5` timed passes. Driver run verbatim results: {"measure": "time_to_90", "digits": 3, "seed": 20260612, "double_seconds_to_target": 7.4, "baseline_seconds_to_target": 5.38, both 400 steps}; {"digits": 3, "seed": 7, 7.96 vs 4.46, both 300 steps}; {"digits": 5, "seed": 20260612, 23.83 vs 16.54, 500 vs 600 steps}; {"digits": 5, "seed": 7, 11.54 vs 20.84, 400 vs 1100 steps}. Latency: 3d batch-500 ms {baseline 22.0, double 46.8, vote 424.8}, batch-1 {1.6, 2.3, 20.8}; 5d batch-500 {76.5, 115.7, 741.0}, batch-1 {3.1, 3.3, 30.3}. Proving tests written first: train_steps count+weight-update, time_to_target zero-target crossing at first eval, unreachable-target sentinel, latency positivity and vote>greedy ordering. make pyaot clean (83 files); make lint currently exits 2 on "Would reformat: tests/test_clock_quantization.py" — a foreign agent's file outside this task's scope, untouched per scope rules; my files pass ruff format/check.

**What worked:** The harness; the interleaved design charges each system only its own training cost while sharing dataset build and eval. Single-prompt latency near-parity confirms the structural argument: the diffusion thinker spends 6 fixed parallel passes regardless of length while AR costs grow linearly with output length — at 5 digits the gap is already 0.2 ms.

**What failed:** Nothing in code. Honest negative results recorded: at 3-digit difficulty the baseline reaches 90% in equal steps, so the double decoder's two-model sequential training makes it strictly slower in wall-clock; 5-digit seed 20260612 also favored the baseline on seconds despite fewer double steps. The step advantage only converts to a wall-clock win when it is large (seed 7: 2.75x fewer steps -> 1.8x faster).

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept harness, 4 proving tests, docs entries, all measurement data. Nothing discarded. layers note: thinker and talker training is embarrassingly parallel (talker consumes ground-truth thoughts, not thinker output) — on two devices the double wall-clock would be max() not sum(), flipping the 3-digit comparison to near-parity and widening seed-7's win; not implemented (single shared device this session).

**Open questions / next steps:** (1) Parallel thinker/talker training measurement once the GPU frees up. (2) Time-to-90% variance is high across seeds; more seeds needed before strong claims. (3) Vote-of-8's ~10x inference cost buys little accuracy at converged models — adaptive K (vote only on low-margin prompts) untested. (4) Foreign unformatted file tests/test_clock_quantization.py breaks make lint repo-wide; needs its owner to run make fix.
EOF
